toolkit.name: Bitbucket
toolkit.description: Bitbucket is a Git-based code hosting and collaboration platform supporting private and public repositories, enabling teams to manage and review code through pull requests and integrations

tools.name: Approve Pull Request
tools.description: Tool to approve a pull request as the authenticated user. Use when you need to formally approve changes in a pull request review process.

input.title: ApprovePullRequestRequest

repo_slug.title: Repo Slug
repo_slug.description: Repository slug (URL-friendly name).

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Workspace ID or slug (URL-friendly name).

pull_request_id.title: Pull Request Id
pull_request_id.description: The ID of the pull request to approve.

tools.name: Browse repository path
tools.description: Tool to retrieve content for a file path or browse directory contents at a specified revision in a Bitbucket repository. Use when you need flexible access to repository content - returns raw file data for files or paginated directory listings for directories.

q.title: Q
q.description: Filter query string using Bitbucket's REST API filtering syntax to narrow results. Only applicable when browsing directories.

page.title: Page
page.description: Page number for paginated results (starts from 1). Only applicable when browsing directories.

path.title: Path
path.description: File or directory path within the repository to browse. Use empty string for root directory.

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Field name for sorting results. Prefix with '-' for descending order. Only applicable when browsing directories.

commit.title: Commit
commit.description: Commit hash, branch name, or tag to browse from. Defaults to 'master' if not specified.

format.title: Format
format.description: Response format. Use 'meta' to return metadata as JSON instead of raw file contents when browsing a file.

pagelen.title: Pagelen
pagelen.description: Number of entries per page (1-100). Only applicable when browsing directories. Controls pagination size.

max_depth.title: Max Depth
max_depth.description: Maximum depth for breadth-first recursive directory traversal. Only applicable when path is a directory. Large values may cause timeouts.

repo_slug.title: Repo Slug
repo_slug.description: Repository slug or UUID (typically URL-formatted name).

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Workspace ID or UUID (often username or team name) containing the repository.

tools.name: Create a branch
tools.description: Creates a new branch in a Bitbucket repository from a target commit hash; the branch name must be unique, adhere to Bitbucket's naming conventions, and not include the 'refs/heads/' prefix.

input.title: CreateBranchRequest

name.title: Name
name.description: The name for the new branch (e.g., 'feature/new-login', 'bugfix/issue-123'). Important: Do not include the 'refs/heads/' prefix.

repo_slug.title: Repo Slug
repo_slug.description: The slug or UUID of the repository where the branch will be created. This is usually the repository's name in URL-friendly format.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: The workspace ID or UUID that owns the repository. This can typically be found in the URL of your Bitbucket workspace.

target_hash.title: Target Hash
target_hash.description: The full commit hash (SHA1) from which the new branch will be created. This commit must exist in the repository.

input.description: Request model for creating a new branch in a Bitbucket repository.

tools.name: Create an issue
tools.description: Creates a new issue in a Bitbucket repository, setting the authenticated user as reporter; ensures assignee (if provided) has repository access, and that any specified milestone, version, or component IDs exist.

due_on.title: Due On
due_on.description: Due date for the issue in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ').

content.title: Content
examples: Users are unable to log in when using Firefox browser
content.description: Detailed description for the new issue.

assignee.title: Assignee
assignee.description: Bitbucket username of the assignee. The assignee must have repository access.

repo_slug.title: Repo Slug
repo_slug.description: The slug of the Bitbucket repository.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: The ID or slug of the Bitbucket workspace.

version_id.title: Version Id
version_id.description: Numeric ID of an existing version to associate with this issue.

component_id.title: Component Id
component_id.description: Numeric ID of an existing component to associate with this issue.

milestone_id.title: Milestone Id
milestone_id.description: Numeric ID of an existing milestone to associate with this issue.

tools.name: Create an issue comment
tools.description: Adds a new comment with markdown support to an existing Bitbucket issue.

input.title: CreateIssueCommentRequest

content.title: Content
examples: This is a comment with **bold** text
content.description: The raw text content for the comment. This content supports markdown formatting, which Bitbucket will then render.

issue_id.title: Issue Id
issue_id.description: The unique identifier of the issue on which the comment will be posted.

repo_slug.title: Repo Slug
repo_slug.description: The slug (URL-friendly version) of the repository name.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: The ID or slug of the workspace or user that owns the repository.

input.description: Request model for creating a comment on a Bitbucket issue.

tools.name: Create a pull request
tools.description: Creates a new pull request in a specified Bitbucket repository, ensuring the source branch exists and is distinct from the (optional) destination branch.

title.title: Title
examples: Fix: Resolve issue with user authentication
title.description: Concise title summarizing the changes for the pull request.

repo_slug.title: Repo Slug
repo_slug.description: Slug (URL-friendly name) of the repository for the pull request.

uuid.title: Uuid
uuid.description: UUID of the Bitbucket user to be a reviewer.

reviewers.title: Reviewers
reviewers.description: List of Bitbucket user UUIDs to be added as reviewers. Malformed or non-existent UUIDs trigger validation errors.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Workspace ID (UUID or slug) of the repository owner.

description.title: Description
examples: This PR adds a new login page with improved security features and a redesigned UI. It addresses ticket #123.
Fixes a critical bug in the payment processing module that caused incorrect transaction amounts.
description.description: Detailed Markdown description of the pull request, outlining changes and purpose.

source_branch.title: Source Branch
source_branch.description: Name of the source branch with changes to be merged.

destination_branch.title: Destination Branch
destination_branch.description: Name of the destination branch for merging; defaults to repository's main branch if unspecified.

close_source_branch.title: Close Source Branch
close_source_branch.description: If true, automatically closes the source branch upon pull request merge.

tools.name: Create pull request comment
tools.description: Creates a new comment on a Bitbucket pull request. Supports top-level comments, threaded replies, and inline code comments. Use when providing feedback on a PR, replying to existing comments, or commenting on specific code lines.

input.title: CreatePullRequestCommentRequest

inline.title: InlineCommentLocation

to.title: To
to.description: Ending line number for multi-line inline comments. If omitted, comment applies to from_line only.

from.title: From
from.description: Starting line number for the inline comment. Use None for added lines only.

path.title: Path
path.description: File path in the repository where the inline comment should be placed.

inline.description: Location details for inline code comments.

repo_slug.title: Repo Slug
repo_slug.description: The slug (URL-friendly version) of the repository name.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: The ID or slug of the workspace that owns the repository.

content_raw.title: Content Raw
content_raw.description: The raw text content for the comment. Supports markdown formatting which Bitbucket will render.

pull_request_id.title: Pull Request Id
pull_request_id.description: The unique identifier of the pull request to comment on.

parent_comment_id.title: Parent Comment Id
parent_comment_id.description: ID of an existing comment to reply to, creating a threaded comment. If omitted, creates a top-level comment.

input.description: Request model for creating a comment on a Bitbucket pull request.

tools.name: List commits from revision (POST)
tools.description: Tool to list commits from a revision using POST method. Identical to GET endpoint but allows sending include/exclude parameters in request body to avoid URL length limits. Use when include/exclude parameters are too long for query strings.

input.title: CreateRepositoriesCommits2Request

page.title: Page
page.description: Page number for paginated results (starts from 1).

path.title: Path
path.description: Optional file path to filter commits. Only commits that modified this file or directory will be returned.

exclude.title: Exclude
exclude.description: Optional commit hash or branch to exclude from the results. Can be used to create a range with the 'include' parameter. Use POST method when this value is very long.

include.title: Include
include.description: Optional commit hash or branch to include in the results. Can be used to create a range with the 'exclude' parameter. Use POST method when this value is very long.

pagelen.title: Pagelen
pagelen.description: Number of commits per page (1-100). Bitbucket default is typically 30 if not specified.

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: The commit hash, branch name, tag, or other revision identifier to start listing commits from. Commits are returned in reverse chronological order starting from this revision.

repo_slug.title: Repo Slug
repo_slug.description: The slug of the repository. This is the repository's name, usually in lowercase and with hyphens instead of spaces.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: The workspace ID (slug) or UUID of the Bitbucket workspace that owns the repository. This can be the workspace name or its universally unique identifier.

input.description: Request model for listing commits from a revision using POST.

repo_slug.description: URL-friendly slug for the new repository.

has_issues.title: Has Issues

is_private.title: Is Private

fork_policy.title: Fork Policy
fork_policy.description: Forking policy for the repository, determining who can create forks.

project_key.title: Project Key
project_key.description: Key of the Bitbucket project for the repository; if omitted, it's placed in the workspace's oldest project.

tools.name: Get Commit Diff
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the unified diff between two provided revisions or for a single commit in a Bitbucket repository. Use when you need to see the actual code changes in a commit or between two commits. Supports filtering by file path and various diff options.

input.title: GetCommitDiffRequest

path.title: Path
path.description: Optional file path to filter the diff to a specific file or directory. If omitted, returns diff for all changes.

spec.title: Spec
spec.description: A commit SHA, branch name, tag, or revspec (e.g. '3a8b42..9ff173' for range). For a single commit, provide the commit hash. For comparing two commits, use 'commit1..commit2' format.

merge.title: Merge
merge.description: Whether to generate merge diff. Set to true for merge commit diffs.

topic.title: Topic
topic.description: Whether to generate a 2-way three-dot diff when spec contains two commits. Set to true to use three-dot diff notation.

binary.title: Binary
binary.description: Whether to include binary file diffs. Set to true to include binary diffs in the output.

context.title: Context
context.description: Number of context lines to include around changes. If not specified, uses the default context lines.

renames.title: Renames
renames.description: Whether to detect file renames. Set to true to show rename detection in the diff.

repo_slug.title: Repo Slug
repo_slug.description: The repository slug (URL-friendly name).

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: The workspace ID or username that owns the repository.

ignore_whitespace.title: Ignore Whitespace
ignore_whitespace.description: Whether to ignore whitespace changes in the diff. Set to true to exclude whitespace-only changes.

input.description: Request to get the diff for a commit or between two revisions.

pagelen.title: Pagelen
pagelen.description: Controls the number of items per page. Must be between 1 and 100.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: The identifier of the Bitbucket workspace. This can be the workspace slug (e.g., 'my-workspace') or its UUID enclosed in curly braces (e.g., '{workspace-uuid}').

input.description: Request model for the ListWorkspaceProjects action. Specifies the workspace and optional query parameters for filtering and sorting projects.

tools.name: List workspaces
tools.description: Lists Bitbucket workspaces accessible to the authenticated user, optionally filtered and sorted. Results are paginated; follow the `next` field in each response to retrieve subsequent pages until `next` is absent. When multiple workspaces are returned, verify the correct `slug` or UUID before passing to downstream tools.

input.title: ListWorkspacesRequest

q.title: Q
q.description: Query string to filter workspaces by attributes, following Bitbucket's filtering syntax.

page.title: Page
page.description: Page number of the results to retrieve. Defaults to 1 if not specified.

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Field to sort returned workspaces by; prefix with a hyphen (-) for descending order.

pagelen.title: Pagelen
pagelen.description: Number of results per page (1-100). Defaults to 10 if not specified.

input.description: Request model for the ListWorkspaces action. Specifies optional query parameters for filtering and sorting workspaces.

tools.name: Merge Pull Request
tools.description: Tool to merge a Bitbucket Cloud pull request via the REST API. Use when you need to complete a PR merge after approval and checks pass. Supports custom merge messages, merge strategies, and source branch deletion.

input.title: MergePullRequestRequest

message.title: Message
message.description: Custom merge commit message. If not provided, Bitbucket generates a default message.

repo_slug.title: Repo Slug
repo_slug.description: Repository slug (URL-friendly name).

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Workspace ID or slug (URL-friendly name).

merge_strategy.title: Merge Strategy
merge_strategy.description: Merge strategy to use. Common values include 'merge_commit', 'squash', 'fast_forward'. If not specified, uses the repository's default merge strategy.

pull_request_id.title: Pull Request Id
pull_request_id.description: The ID of the pull request to merge.

close_source_branch.title: Close Source Branch
close_source_branch.description: Whether to close the source branch after merging. If not specified, uses the repository's default setting.

input.description: Request to merge a pull request.

tools.name: Resolve pull request comment
tools.description: Tool to resolve or reopen a pull request comment thread. Use when marking a comment as addressed during review or reopening a previously resolved thread.

input.title: ResolvePullRequestCommentRequest

action.title: Action
action.description: Action to perform: 'resolve' marks the comment thread as addressed, 'reopen' unmarks it.

repo_slug.title: Repo Slug
repo_slug.description: The repository slug (URL-friendly name).

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: The workspace slug or UUID that owns the repository.

comment_id.title: Comment Id
comment_id.description: The unique identifier for the comment to resolve or reopen.

pull_request_id.title: Pull Request Id
pull_request_id.description: The unique identifier of the pull request.

input.description: Request model for resolving or reopening a pull request comment thread.

tools.name: Update Pull Request
tools.description: Tool to update an existing pull request's editable fields (e.g., title, description, reviewers) via the Bitbucket Cloud API. Use when you need to modify a pull request without creating a new one. Only sends fields that are explicitly provided to avoid accidental overwrites.

input.title: UpdatePullRequestRequest

draft.title: Draft
draft.description: If true, marks the pull request as a draft. If false, marks it as ready for review. If omitted, draft status remains unchanged.

title.title: Title
title.description: Updated title for the pull request. If omitted, title remains unchanged.

repo_slug.title: Repo Slug
repo_slug.description: Repository slug (URL-friendly name) or UUID.

uuid.title: Uuid
uuid.description: UUID of the Bitbucket user to be a reviewer. Must be in Bitbucket's standard format with curly braces.

reviewers.title: Reviewers
reviewers.description: Updated list of Bitbucket user UUIDs to be reviewers. Replaces existing reviewers. If omitted, reviewers remain unchanged.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Workspace ID (slug) or workspace UUID that owns the repository.

description.title: Description
examples: This PR refactors the authentication module to improve security and maintainability.
description.description: Updated Markdown description for the pull request. If omitted, description remains unchanged.

pull_request_id.title: Pull Request Id
pull_request_id.description: Unique ID of the pull request to update.

close_source_branch.title: Close Source Branch
close_source_branch.description: If true, automatically closes the source branch upon pull request merge. If omitted, setting remains unchanged.

input.description: Request to update an existing pull request's editable fields.

tools.name: Update commit comment
tools.description: Updates the contents of a comment on a commit. Use when you need to modify an existing comment's text on a commit.

input.title: UpdateRepositoriesCommitCommentsRequest

commit.title: Commit
commit.description: The commit hash to update the comment on.

repo_slug.title: Repo Slug
repo_slug.description: The repository slug (URL-friendly name).

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: The workspace slug or UUID that owns the repository.

comment_id.title: Comment Id
comment_id.description: The unique identifier for the comment to update.

content_raw.title: Content Raw
content_raw.description: The updated raw text content for the comment. Supports markdown formatting.

input.description: Request model for updating a commit comment.
